messages:
nina: quick heads-up: small spike in mTLS handshake fails in ap-northeast and eu-west — logs show 'session ticket HMAC mismatch' and occasional 'KMS DecryptDenied'. anyone touched IAM or rotator keys? :wave:

omar: i ran a targeted RBAC cleanup at 03:10Z removing old service accounts. i _think_ rotator was excluded but will check immediately.

nina: paste of proxy log: ```2026-04-05T03:18:12Z proxy-eu-west tls: session ticket HMAC mismatch id=0x9f1a
2026-04-05T03:18:12Z proxy-eu-west kms: DecryptDenied key=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/rotator/cryptoKeys/rotator-key```

security-oncall: checking KMS audit — see a handful of 403s from serviceAccount:rotator@redwood-prod at 03:18:11-03:18:20Z. rotator rotated keys at 03:09Z per rotator-bot. hypothesis: rotation + RBAC prune removed decrypt permission causing validation fallback to fail.

omar: confirmed i inadvertently removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from rotator binding in the prune. opening a fast patch to re-add for a temporary exception.

nina: prefer re-add + increase ticket cache TTL rather than disabling extra validation. please also add a test to the prune job to avoid touching known rotator bindings.

rotator-bot: Rotation recorded: rotator-key v12 deployed 2026-04-05T03:09Z.

omar: re-granted `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to serviceAccount:rotator@redwood-prod and posted IAM change PR #4790. also bumped TICKET_CACHE_TTL from 12m to 48m in canary.

security-oncall: set alert: `rate(session_ticket.hmac_mismatch[15m]) > 0.001` -> page oncall. monitoring shows errors back to baseline at +22m.

nina: thanks — follow-up: add a CI gate to RBAC prune to assert rotator SA keeps decrypt role, and add a note in the rotator playbook. closing for now. :lock:
